blocks.en: The dual space of a Hilbert space is very simple: it is isometric to the space itself. This result is known as the Riesz Representation Theorem and is one of the foundations of the theory of Hilbert spaces.
blocks.zh: Hilbert 空间的对偶空间十分简单: 它与该空间本身等距. 这一结果称为 Riesz 表示定理, 是 Hilbert 空间理论的基础之一.

blocks.en:
As the statement of the theorem indicates, for every $x\in H$ we can define a linear functional $l_x$ using \eqref{eq:hilbert-riesz-inner-product-functional}. It follows from the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality that $l_x\in H^*$ and that $\|l_x\|\leq\|x\|$. Furthermore, by setting $y=x$, we find $\|l_x\|=\|x\|$.

On the other hand, let $l$ be a nonzero linear functional on $H$. We define $M=\{y\in H\mid l(y)=0\}$. Then $M$ is a closed subspace of $H$. Furthermore, $M^\perp$ is one-dimensional since for any $u$ and $v$ in $M^\perp$ we have $l(v)u-l(u)v\in M$. (This implies $l(v)u-l(u)v=0$.)

Now, let $\widetilde x$ be a unit vector in $M^\perp$. For every $y\in H$, we have the decomposition $y=(\widetilde x,y)\widetilde x+z$, where $z\in M$, and hence $l(y)=(\widetilde x,y)l(\widetilde x)$. Thus, if we let
\begin{equation}\label{eq:riesz-representing-vector-from-kernel-complement}
x=\overline{l(\widetilde x)}\widetilde x,
\end{equation}
we see that $l=l_x:=(x,\cdot)$. The equality of the norms has already been established.
blocks.zh:
如定理的陈述所示, 对每个 $x\in H$, 可以利用 \eqref{eq:hilbert-riesz-inner-product-functional} 定义线性泛函 $l_x$. 由 Cauchy-Schwarz 不等式, 有 $l_x\in H^*$ 且 $\|l_x\|\leq\|x\|$. 此外, 令 $y=x$, 得到 $\|l_x\|=\|x\|$.

另一方面, 设 $l$ 为 $H$ 上的非零线性泛函. 定义 $M=\{y\in H\mid l(y)=0\}$. 那么 $M$ 为 $H$ 的闭子空间. 此外, $M^\perp$ 为一维, 因为对 $M^\perp$ 中任意 $u$ 和 $v$, 有 $l(v)u-l(u)v\in M$. (这意味着 $l(v)u-l(u)v=0$.)

现在设 $\widetilde x$ 为 $M^\perp$ 中的单位向量. 对每个 $y\in H$, 有分解 $y=(\widetilde x,y)\widetilde x+z$, 其中 $z\in M$, 因而 $l(y)=(\widetilde x,y)l(\widetilde x)$. 于是, 若令
\begin{equation}\label{eq:riesz-representing-vector-from-kernel-complement}
x=\overline{l(\widetilde x)}\widetilde x,
\end{equation}
就可看到 $l=l_x:=(x,\cdot)$. 范数的相等性已经得到证明.

blocks.en: In the previous proof we constructed isomorphic mappings $A_H:H^*\to H$ and $A_H^{-1}:H\to H^*$ between a Hilbert space and the corresponding element of its dual; these are called the \emph{Riesz mappings}.
blocks.zh: 在前面的证明中, 构造了 Hilbert 空间及其对偶的相应元素之间的同构映射 $A_H:H^*\to H$ 和 $A_H^{-1}:H\to H^*$; 它们称为 \emph{Riesz 映射}.
blocks.label: rem:riesz-mappings

blocks.en: Let $X$ be a Banach space. Then every $x\in X$ defines a linear functional on $X^*$ by the correspondence $l_xy=y(x)$. It is clear that $\|l_x\|\leq\|x\|$, and it follows from the Hahn-Banach theorem (Theorem~\ref{thm:hahn-banach-extension}), stated in the next subsection~\ref{subsec:hahn-banach-theorem}, that there is a $y\in X^*$ with $\|y\|=1$ and $y(x)=\|x\|$. This implies that $\|l_x\|=\|x\|$, and hence we have an isometry from $X$ to a subspace of $X^{**}$. It is important to characterize those Banach spaces for which this isometry is onto.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 为 Banach 空间. 那么每个 $x\in X$ 都通过对应关系 $l_xy=y(x)$ 定义了 $X^*$ 上的线性泛函. 显然 $\|l_x\|\leq\|x\|$, 并且由将在下一小节~\ref{subsec:hahn-banach-theorem} 陈述的 Hahn-Banach 定理 (Theorem~\ref{thm:hahn-banach-extension}), 存在 $y\in X^*$, 使 $\|y\|=1$ 且 $y(x)=\|x\|$. 这意味着 $\|l_x\|=\|x\|$, 因而得到从 $X$ 到 $X^{**}$ 的一个子空间的等距映射. 刻画这一等距映射为满射的那些 Banach 空间十分重要.
blocks.label: ex:canonical-bidual-isometry

blocks.en: A Banach space is called \textbf{reflexive} if the isometry $x\mapsto l_x$ from $X\to X^{**}$ defined by $l_xy=y(x)$ is surjective.
blocks.zh: 若由 $l_xy=y(x)$ 定义的从 $X\to X^{**}$ 的等距映射 $x\mapsto l_x$ 为满射, 则称 Banach 空间\textbf{自反}.
blocks.label: def:reflexive-banach-space

blocks.en: It is clear from Theorem~\ref{thm:hilbert-riesz-representation} that all Hilbert spaces are reflexive. Also, the spaces $L^p(\Omega)$, $1<p<\infty$ are reflexive. By contrast, it can be shown that $L^1(\Omega)$ and $L^\infty(\Omega)$ are not reflexive. Reflexive spaces have many useful properties that make them advantageous for analysis. In the remainder of the book, we shall mostly work in Hilbert spaces, and we shall not pursue reflexive Banach spaces further. The reader is referred to the literature, e.g., \cite{DS}.
blocks.zh: 由 Theorem~\ref{thm:hilbert-riesz-representation} 显然可知, 所有 Hilbert 空间都自反. 此外, 空间 $L^p(\Omega)$, $1<p<\infty$, 也自反. 相比之下, 可以证明 $L^1(\Omega)$ 和 $L^\infty(\Omega)$ 不自反. 自反空间具有许多有用的性质, 因而便于分析. 在本书其余部分中, 将主要在 Hilbert 空间中工作, 不再进一步研究自反 Banach 空间. 请读者参阅有关文献, 例如 \cite{DS}.
